name: cave-context
description: Unifies caveman + context-mode into one non-competing MCP server: proxies all context-mode ctx_* tools 1-to-1 and aggregates both plugins' hooks.

caveman_level.title: Caveman compression level
caveman_level.description: Values: lite | full | ultra — default terse-output level injected at session start and used by bare /caveman; invalid/missing falls back to lite. Default: lite.
